title: The Component That Was Not Ready Yet: Asynchronous Loading, a Status Nobody Checked and a Wait That Gives Up
fallback: This lesson is about a component that loads while the event loop runs, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-06 is about waiting without spinning and giving up after a time, in plain C++. Without Qt, do that and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a wait that runs the event loop until a QML component is ready, has failed or has taken too long, and says which
